name: MIDServerFinder
title: MIDServerFinder - Global
summary: The MIDServerFinder script include provides methods to find a list of MID Servers for specified IP addresses.
overview: Use in server scripts to get the MID Server list.

members.name: getMIDServers
members.summary: Gets the names of MID servers available for a given range and capability.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Array An array of MID server names. If no MID servers are available, returns an empty array. 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
msf.setRanges('10.10.10.1-10.10.11.254');
var msnames = msf.getMIDServers();
 
for(var i=0; i<msnames.length; i++) {
  gs.print(msnames[i]);
};

members.name: getMIDServersBySysId
members.summary: Gets the sys_ids of MID servers available for a given range and capability.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Array An array of MID server sys_ids. If no MID servers are available, returns an empty array. 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
msf.setRanges('10.10.10.1-10.10.11.254');
var msids = msf.getMIDServersBySysId();
 
for(var i=0; i<msids.length; i++) {
  gs.print(msids[i]);
};

members.name: getStatusMessage
members.summary: Gets the state of the finder operation.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String The status message 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
gs.print(msf.getStatusMessage());

members.name: setActive
members.summary: Sets whether to look for active or inactive MID servers. By default, searches are for active MID servers unless inactive is specified by this method.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
flag Boolean If true, look for inactive MID servers. If false, do not look for inactive MID servers.
Returns
Type Description
void 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
msf.setActive('true');

members.name: setCapabilities
members.summary: Sets the technologies for which to look.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
capabilities Array Contains a list of capabilities, for example - capabilities = ["ssh","wmi","snmp",{"os_domain":"disco"},{"phase":1}];
Returns
Type Description
void 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
msf.setRanges('10.10.10.1-10.10.11.254');
var capab = ["ssh","wmi","snmp"];
msf.setCapabilities(capab);

members.name: setDebug
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
onOrOff Boolean True to turn on debugging; false to turn debugging off.
Returns
Type Description
void 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
msf.setDebug('true');

members.name: setRanges
members.summary: Sets the range of IP addresses for which to look.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
ranges String A comma-separated list in one of these formats.
  • IP addresses (10.10.10.1, 10.10.10.2)
  • IP networks (10.10.10.0/23)
  • IP ranges (10.10.10.1-10.10.11.254)
Returns
Type Description
void 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
msf.setRanges('10.10.10.1-10.10.11.254');

members.name: setRangesByIPOrHostname
members.summary: Determines if the input is a single IP or a hostname, and passes the IP or multiple IPs to the setRanges() method.
members.html:
If the value of ipOrHostname is an IP address, it is passed into the setRanges() method. It the value is a hostname, we look up the DNS table (cmdb_ip_address_dns_name) to try resolving the hostname. The result, either an IP or multiple IPs, is then passes into the setRanges() method.

Parameters
Name Type Description
ipOrHostname String The IP address, IP range, or host name.
Returns
Type Description
void 
var msf = new MIDServerFinder();
msf.setRangesByIPOrHostname('10.10.10.1-10.10.11.254');
